keySentence: She was as small as a thumb.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Thumbelina was tiny. Her bed was a walnut. She sang pretty songs. She was as small as a thumb.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Thumbelina lived in a tiny world made just for her. She was as small as a thumb and slept in a walnut shell. Her blanket was a soft flower petal from the garden. She loved to sing and the birds listened to her songs. Her mother cared for her and kept her warm and safe. But Thumbelina dreamed of seeing the big world outside.
